function varargout = qpOASES_sequence(action, varargin)
persistent closedHandles;
if isempty(closedHandles)
    closedHandles = zeros(0, 1);
end

switch action
    case 'c'
        closedHandles(end + 1, 1) = varargin{1};
        return;
    case 'testClosedHandles'
        varargout = {closedHandles};
        return;
end

opts = varargin{end};
results = {opts.solution, 0, opts.exitflag, 1, opts.multipliers, struct('cpuTime', 0.002)};
if strcmp(action, 'i')
    results = [{42}, results];
end
varargout = results(1:nargout);
end
